Conversation, family & daily routines

coming! phrase

also I’ll be right there, I’m coming

classical

Traupman 101

Jam aderō.

I’ll be right there, coming!

Examples

  • Tum dēmum pater fīliō respondit: «Jam aderō.»

    Only then did Dad answer his son: “Coming.”Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

  • «Mātūrā,» inquit pater. «Raeda mox aderit.» «Jam aderō, tata!»

    “Hurry up,” said Dad. “The taxi will be here soon.” “Coming, Dad!”Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

See also wait a moment!, hurry up!.

SourcesLewis & Short: adsum

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 101, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
